project.title: stone_bridge independent right/top artwork
project.description: Two independent full-resolution cameras derived from the reviewed original front ornament design.
project.art_direction: Match the supplied established fish/aquascape illustration for detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART: deliberate fine crisp pixel clusters, coherent painted volume, restrained believable colors and readable material wear. No smooth CGI, photograph, low-poly render, chibi toy, uniform procedural noise or thick black comic outline. One complete isolated object on pure white, generous clean white margin, no floor or cast shadow, no water, fish, plants, text, labels or extra objects. No diagram, collage or packed views. Preserve full native resolution.

brief.name: stone_bridge_right
brief.description:
Render ONE RIGHT view of the EXACT SAME designed ornament shown in the supplied FRONT artwork, not a new similar object. Subject: One small carved weathered gray-green aquarium stone footbridge, 30 cm wide, 13 cm deep and about 15 cm high. Exactly one broad semicircular arch passes fully under the curved deck from front to rear. Two broad uneven piers rest at left and right. A low solid stone coping along each long side, no separate thin balusters. The arch opening is about 45 percent of bridge width and reaches about 45 percent of total height; show the pure white background through the open underpass. Muted cool gray stone with restrained moss-colored surface staining, no separate moss plants, no water or landscape. Individual large worn masonry blocks, no decorative text.
Match the supplied established fish/aquascape illustration for detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART: deliberate fine crisp pixel clusters, coherent painted volume, restrained believable colors and readable material wear. No smooth CGI, photograph, low-poly render, chibi toy, uniform procedural noise or thick black comic outline. One complete isolated object on pure white, generous clean white margin, no floor or cast shadow, no water, fish, plants, text, labels or extra objects. No diagram, collage or packed views. Preserve full native resolution.
Strict orthographic RIGHT END ELEVATION, camera at +X looking along -X. Horizontal image axis is -Z depth, vertical is Y. The front long horizontal X axis disappears into the image: ship/bridge/pipe/chest must be seen END-ON, not their long front again. For the pipe show the genuinely open round end mouth.
Preserve every actual source component, relative proportion, worn edge, opening, material color and landmark as the same physical object from the new direction. Actual reference proportions take priority over approximate descriptive dimensions. Infer hidden surfaces consistently; do not invent extra feet, posts, holes or decorations. Genuine tunnels remain open; jar and cargo-well cavities have solid bottoms. This is one full-resolution camera-specific art donor, no other views or annotations.

stages.notes: Pure-white validate must pass before trim/matte.
